perception.why: bond-order perception must succeed on essentially every 3D sample; a failure means the structure cannot be drawn unambiguously

geometry.why: mean |measured - ideal| bond length within 15% of the covalent norm (loose first-pass floor for distance-built geometry)

pains.why: PAINS alerts are assay artifacts; a model that rediscovers them optimises against interference, not activity

in_domain.why: most candidates should sit inside the applicability domain; beyond it, learned oracles (BBB%, QED, ESOL) extrapolate

soluble.why: majority should clear the conventional logS >= -4 mol/L aqueous-solubility floor

routes.why: at least half the routability that REAL training compounds achieve under the identical bounded search — absolute 2-step rates are dataset-specific (BBBP-like space: ~1% even for purchasable drugs; QM9-size: near 100%), so an absolute threshold would fail real chemistry
